name: @sahelflow/marketing-remotion
description: SahelFlow premium marketing and product-demonstration films built with Remotion.

scripts.studio: npm run generate:score && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:launch: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Premium-Launch-60 renders/sahelflow-premium-launch-60.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:social: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Premium-Social-30 renders/sahelflow-premium-social-30.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:vertical: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Premium-Vertical-15 renders/sahelflow-premium-vertical-15.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:demo: npm run prepare:render && remotion render src/index.ts SahelFlow-Premium-Demo-90 renders/sahelflow-premium-demo-90.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --overwrite
scripts.render:preview: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:social
scripts.render:all: npm run render:vertical && npm run render:social && npm run render:launch && npm run render:demo
